articles.title: Spanish intelligence warned of Ceuta mass crossing plans before surge
articles.description: Declassified documents show Spanish and Moroccan authorities were alerted to social media calls for a mass migrant crossing the day before tens of thousands entered Ceuta.

articles.title: Oil hits $100 a barrel for first time since July after US and Houthi strikes
articles.description: Brent crude - the global benchmark for prices - rises after the US hit five Iranian tankers on Tuesday

articles.title: Iran referred to UN Security Council for nuclear non-compliance
articles.description: Tehran condemns the resolution, blaming US and Israeli strikes on its nuclear facilities for disrupting inspections.

articles.title: Germany's Merz attacks AfD in stormy debate after far-right election win
articles.description: Germany's chancellor clashes with AfD leader Alice Weidel, saying her migration policy amounts to "ethnic cleansing" for skilled workers.

articles.title: Uganda pulling out of Prince Harry's Invictus Games, says military chief
articles.description: The decision, announced by the chief of defence, comes just two months after Uganda said it would participate.

articles.title: Two die at Moldovan border as Russia-Ukraine drone war rages
articles.description: Five deaths are reported in Ukraine and four in Russia as both sides launch new drone strikes.

articles.title: Spanish spies warned of mass migrant crossing into Ceuta the day before
articles.description: Spanish spies warned their Moroccan counterparts and the Madrid government of the Ceuta migrant surge a day before it happened.

articles.title: Oil rises above $100 a barrel as Middle East conflict escalates - use our tracker to see impact on prices
articles.description: There is mounting concern over the impact of intensifying hostilities in the Middle East on the global economy, as oil prices topped $100 a barrel again.
